goal: Implement the complete offline local-data layer in a new shared:data KMP module: SQLDelight schema/queries/migrations/drivers, typed Settings, private photo storage contracts/adapters, domain manager implementations, immutable snapshots, transactional staged backup/restore, CSV export, complete erasure, and deterministic cross-platform tests. Store only stable localization keys for built-in catalog data. Do not edit settings.gradle.kts or the version catalog; the orchestrator will wire the module/tool aliases separately.
acceptanceCriteria: All managed entities and immutable snapshots are represented with stable IDs, constraints, indexes, explicit ordering, and transactional writes.
Android, iOS, and test SQLDelight drivers plus Settings and private file adapters have explicit lifecycle and do not leak generated row types.
Backup preview/replace is validate-first and atomic across database and staged photos; invalid, cancelled, corrupt, unsupported, repeat, and insufficient-storage cases preserve existing state.
CSV is UTF-8, escaped, documented, excludes photos, and is not restorable.
Delete-all clears database, private photos, settings/privacy caches, and reminder metadata while retaining no invented external effect.
Deterministic tests cover CRUD, referential integrity, migrations, rollback, restart, reactive emissions, Settings fallbacks, snapshots, backup/photo integrity, CSV, and erasure.
No external secrets, translated built-in text, Firebase/Yandex SDK logic, UI, Stores, or platform picker/notification APIs are added.
